params.body:
Pins the gateway VM to v0.31.0, the release with `issues: read` on the read token (#95).

- `RELEASE` v0.30.0 → v0.31.0
- `GATEWAY_SHA` → `ca9146465539e2537aa35fa267e1826f8648895f95c403f0eb76eeae1db88212`

The sha256 was checked three ways and they agree: the release asset's digest on GitHub, its line in the release's `SHA256SUMS`, and `sha256sum` of the downloaded `control-gateway-linux-amd64`.

The README keeps its measured record of v0.30.0 (22 September 2026): that is what RTMR3 held then, and rewriting it without a new measurement would claim one. A fresh record after the upgrade can replace it.

## After merging (operator, on the Mac)

```bash
gcloud auth login shane@abovebeyond.ai
cd ~/Projects/control && git pull && CONTROL_GCP_PROJECT=elixir-508105 deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh upgrade
gcloud auth revoke --all
```

`upgrade` carries this startup script and reboots (stop and start). The gateway is back within about two minutes.
params.title: The gateway runs v0.31.0
